description: Green streets is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The City of Montreal identified 350 green streets in 2019. A green alley is an alley that has been redeveloped by residents, with the assistance of a borough or eco-neighborhood. The redevelopment of an alley can bring about changes in car traffic: complete, partial or seasonal closure. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Layout, Arr., Citizen, Initiative, PolearTM. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
